issues.description: Page is stuck in a permanent loading/skeleton state. The pre_detection_result data is never loaded or rendered. The room image, furniture item overlays, keep/remove toggles, and Continue button are all missing.
issues.root_cause: The page is likely reading pre_detection_result from localStorage or sessionStorage (which is unavailable during SSR), causing a hydration mismatch and the component staying in its loading skeleton state. The hydration errors confirm server/client HTML mismatch - the server renders without localStorage data, causing the loading state to persist or the hydration to fail and never resolve to the loaded state.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. This means the page SSR output differs from client output, likely because state is initialized from localStorage synchronously.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx, the initial state is likely being read from localStorage during the useState initializer or before a useEffect, causing server/client mismatch. The component needs to use a mounted/isMounted guard before reading localStorage.
